mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, m.name, m.description, m.due_date AS dueDate, m.status, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM milestone m LEFT JOIN project p ON m.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: WHERE m.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY m.due_date, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO milestone (project_id, name, description, due_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
